title: v2 operational diagnostic visibility + daemon boot hardening
author: Jill
plan_section: Discovered 2026-09-08 during v2 LIVE troubleshooting; not in PLAN.md
trigger: Operator 2026-09-08 (verbatim): "OK good so tell me why I haven't been getting Telegram alerts for vehicles driving around my property today." Root-cause audit identified 7 distinct issues, of which 5 were SILENT in production because the daemon emitted no INFO-level logs and stderr captured only Flask's exception handler. This PRD scopes the fixes as a structured change so the same class of failure cannot recur.
background: v2 went LIVE on 2026-09-08 with code-complete pipeline + 8 US-014 webhook-activation stories committed. Telegram alerts stopped. Root-cause audit on 2026-09-08 10:30 EDT found the following silent production failures: (1) infra/camera_creds._parse_env never sets entry["name"], so validate_source_ip always fails for the first lookup, and the /alert handler's fallback loop never matches. (2) pyproject.toml declares av>=11.0 but the venv had no av installed, so the first /alert after IP-validation-passed would 500 with ModuleNotFoundError. (3) listener/daemon.main() never called CameraCaptureRegistry.start_all(), so the persistent RTSP readers never boot — every /alert receives "No reader for camera X; returning empty" and the gate suppresses every alert. (4) No module ever called logging.basicConfig(); six modules instantiate getLogger() but only Flask's WARNING-level exception handler emits to stderr. INFO/DEBUG-level diagnostics from frame_capture, gate, pipeline, quick_classifier, etc. are completely silent. (5) infra/quick_classifier raises FileNotFoundError on first /alert because models/yolov8n.onnx was never downloaded. (6) macOS ObjC class collision between av/.dylibs/libavdevice.62 and cv2/.dylibs/libavdevice.61 may corrupt the av FFmpeg binding (TBD; need post-fix logging to confirm). (7) registry instance verification (does start_all() actually populate _readers?) was impossible without (4).
goal: All seven identified issues fixed end-to-end with verifier commands that prove each, plus an audit-the-class pass that catches every other silent failure of the same shape. Daemon launches fully booted; first /alert from a legit camera returns 200 with frames captured + cooldown recorded + (when classification is vehicle) Telegram alert delivered. Tests pass 116/116+.
non_goals: Do NOT touch /Users/jill/farm-surveillance-refactor/ or /Users/jill/farm-surveillance-internal/. They are frozen archives.
Do NOT touch ~/farm-surveillance/ (v1). v1 is OFF and stays OFF.
Do NOT git push. Operator reviews and pushes.
Do NOT install new skills. Use the existing skill set.
Do NOT add per-class pipeline modules (vehicle_pipeline/, etc.). ONE listener/pipeline.py.
Do NOT introduce a new logging framework (structlog, loguru). Use stdlib logging only.
Do NOT modify pyproject.toml dependencies (av is already declared; install it instead).
Do NOT touch v1's logging setup; out of scope.
constraints: Each story targets <=100 LOC; 150 absolute max. Split before authoring.
Each card body <=2500 chars (Qwen 35B context ceiling).
Sequential dependency chain via hermes kanban link. Only the head of the chain is in `ready`.
Each AC is a shell-runnable command (grep -nE / python3 -c / python3 -m py_compile / pytest). No prose ACs.
Each story ends with `python3 -m pytest tests/ -x --tb=short` returning baseline-or-better test count.
All new code ASCII only. No Unicode, no em-dashes.
Destructive ops (kill/restart/rm) need explicit operator approval per absolute boundary rule — never self-authorize.
Audit-the-class: when one silent failure is identified in a category, scan the WHOLE SYSTEM for the same category and fix all instances.

Logging must be wired ONCE at the daemon entry point so every logger in the v2 codebase (daemon, frame_capture, gate, pipeline, quick_classifier, vision_cache, gate_cooldown, motion_detector) routes to stderr with one consistent format.
Boot verification: every fix that affects daemon startup must be verified by bouncing the daemon and reading logs/daemon-error.log to confirm the new diagnostics land.
test_strategy: Per-story `pytest tests/ -x --tb=short`. Stories that only restructure logging / add boot verification add ZERO new tests; they prove correctness via shell-runnable ACs (kill+bounce+grep, not pytest). Stories that change code semantics add 1-3 tests minimum.
shipping_definition: After US-016 stories land and merge, a synthetic Reolink alert from camera 192.168.1.39 (FRONT) returns HTTP 200 with frame_paths > 0 and Telegram chat 374999219 receives the alert within 30s. Daemon stderr shows: 'Booting RTSP readers for 6 camera(s)...', 'RTSP registry ready.', per-reader decode progress at DEBUG or WARNING on failures, full pipeline stage transitions, and any Telegram send/result. No FileNotFoundError. No ModuleNotFoundError. No 'No reader for camera X' on legit cameras.

stories.title: infra/camera_creds._parse_env: set entry.name from _CAMERA_MAP prefix
stories.card_body_fallback: Full ACs in PRD. Run: grep -n 'entry\["name"\] = camera_name' infra/camera_creds.py | wc -l  (expect >= 2: one for _rtsp_url branch, one for _ip branch). Run: python3 -c 'from infra.camera_creds import get_all_cameras; [print(c.get("name")) for c in get_all_cameras().values()]'  (expect 6 names, no None). Run: pytest tests/ -x --tb=short  (expect 116 passed). Commit: 'US-016a: _parse_env populates entry.name from _CAMERA_MAP'.
ac: AC1: grep -nE 'entry\["name"\]\s*=\s*camera_name' infra/camera_creds.py returns 2 lines (one in _rtsp_url branch, one in _ip branch).
AC2: python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "."); from infra.camera_creds import get_all_cameras; assert all(c.get("name") for c in get_all_cameras().values())' returns exit 0.
stories.rationale: validate_source_ip's fallback loop in listener/daemon.py matches by name. _parse_env never set entry.name, so the loop never matched, every /alert got 403, no Telegram alerts fired.

stories.title: venv install: pyproject-declared runtime deps (av)
stories.card_body_fallback: Full ACs in PRD. Run: pip install av>=11.0  (resolve the only declared-but-missing dep). Run: python3 -c 'import av; print(av.__version__)'  (expect >= 11.0). Add a CI-style check or document the venv-build step. Commit: 'US-016b: install pyproject-declared deps (av) into venv'.
ac: AC2: .venv/bin/python3.11 -c 'import av; print(av.__version__)' prints a version >= 11.0.
stories.rationale: infra/frame_capture.py imports av at module load; missing dep caused 500 ModuleNotFoundError on first /alert after IP validation passed. Fix: ensure venv matches pyproject.toml declared deps.

stories.title: listener/daemon.main: boot CameraCaptureRegistry.start_all() before app.run()
stories.card_body_fallback: Full ACs in PRD. Add 4 lines to listener/daemon.main(): import + log + start_all() + log. Run: grep -n 'CameraCaptureRegistry.start_all' listener/daemon.py  (expect 1 line). After bouncing daemon (kill + launchctl respawn), daemon-error.log should show the boot log (note: requires US-016d first to make INFO visible). Commit: 'US-016c: daemon.main boots RTSP readers before app.run'.
ac: AC1: grep -n 'CameraCaptureRegistry.start_all()' listener/daemon.py returns 1 line (inside main(), before app.run()).
AC2: grep -n 'from infra.frame_capture import CameraCaptureRegistry' listener/daemon.py returns 1 line.
stories.rationale: Without this, the singleton never instantiates; every CameraCaptureRegistry.get() returns None; _get_healthy_reader logs 'No reader for camera X' for every /alert; gate suppresses every alert.

stories.title: listener/daemon: logging.basicConfig at module-import + LOG_LEVEL env var
stories.card_body_fallback: Full ACs in PRD. Add logging.basicConfig block at module-import time, BEFORE app = Flask(__name__), honoring LOG_LEVEL env var (default INFO), format '%%(asctime)s %%(levelname)s %%(name)s: %%(message)s', stream=sys.stderr, force=True. Run: grep -n 'logging.basicConfig' listener/daemon.py  (expect 1 line at module scope, not inside a function). Run: LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG .venv/bin/python3.11 -c 'from listener import daemon'  (expect no error). After bounce, daemon-error.log should show INFO-level diagnostics from frame_capture / pipeline / quick_classifier. Commit: 'US-016d: wire stdlib logging at daemon module-import (LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG)'.
ac: AC2: grep -nE '^\s*log\s*=\s*logging\.getLogger\("daemon"\)' listener/daemon.py returns 1 line at module scope.
AC3: grep -n 'LOG_LEVEL' listener/daemon.py returns 1+ lines (env var is honored).
AC4: pytest tests/ -x --tb=short returns >= 116 passed (logging must not break tests).
stories.rationale: Six modules instantiate getLogger() but never configure root. Without basicConfig, only Flask's WARNING+ exception handler emits to stderr. Silent failures in frame_capture / gate / pipeline / quick_classifier were invisible. Audit-the-class: also verify all 6 loggers are reachable via this single basicConfig (root logger).
stories.audit_class_note: When this lands, every getLogger() across the v2 codebase (daemon, frame_capture, gate, gate_cooldown, vision_cache, quick_classifier, motion_detector) routes to stderr via the same root handler. Verify by running US-016d smoke test and grepping logs/daemon-error.log for each logger name.

stories.title: infra/quick_classifier: hard-fail at startup when model missing + ship yolov8n.onnx
stories.card_body_fallback: Full ACs in PRD. Two parts: (a) download models/yolov8n.onnx from the URL into models/yolov8n.onnx. (b) QuickClassifier.__init__ MUST log FATAL and call sys.exit(1) when models/yolov8n.onnx is missing — operator 2026-09-08 directive: hard-fail, never silently degrade. Per US-016d, the FATAL message will land in logs/daemon-error.log so the failure is visible. Run: ls -la models/yolov8n.onnx  (expect file present, ~6.5MB). Run: rm models/yolov8n.onnx && python3 -m listener.daemon 2>&1 | grep -i 'fatal\|missing'  (expect FATAL logged + daemon exits with non-zero code). Commit: 'US-016e: ship yolov8n.onnx model + hard-fail in QuickClassifier'.
ac: AC1: ls -la models/yolov8n.onnx returns a file >= 6MB.
AC2: grep -nE 'sys\.exit\(1\)' infra/quick_classifier.py returns >= 1 line (hard-fail path exists).
AC3: grep -nE 'raise FileNotFoundError' infra/quick_classifier.py returns 0 lines (no more soft raise on missing model).
AC5: rm models/yolov8n.onnx && LOG_LEVEL=INFO .venv/bin/python3.11 -m listener.daemon 2>&1 | grep -iE 'fatal.*yolov8n|model missing' (expect FATAL message); same command's exit code is non-zero.
stories.rationale: infra/quick_classifier.QuickClassifier.__init__ raised FileNotFoundError when models/yolov8n.onnx was absent, killing every /alert after IP-validation passed. Operator 2026-09-08 directive: HARD FAIL, never silent degradation. Fix: ship the model + raise + log FATAL + sys.exit(1) when missing.

stories.title: unblock gate pipeline: drop code_for indirection + ship motion_gate_thresholds.json
stories.rationale: Discovered 2026-09-08 during v2 LIVE bounce verification (US-016d basicConfig revealed silent crash). gate.py:563 + gate_cooldown.py:166 import from infra.cameras (NEVER SHIPPED). config/motion_gate_thresholds.json (NEVER SHIPPED).
